title: UpdateStatus
description:
What this server knows about updating itself.

The owner, 2026-10-19: "ob der server selber Updates über das Repo abfragen kann und bei bedarf durch den User in der AdminGUI direkt installiert werden kann" — and "gar nicht automatisch prüfen. nur auf knopfdruck." So nothing here is ever fetched unasked: `check` is empty until an administrator has pressed the button since the server started.

check.description: What the last check found, if anybody has asked since the server started.

install.description: What the installer last did, if it has ever run on this machine.

installed.description: The version this server is running.

UpdateCheck.description: What asking the repository for its newest release found.

checked_at.description: When the repository was asked, in milliseconds since the epoch.

latest.description: The newest release's version, such as `0.2.46`, when there was an answer.

newer.description: Whether that is newer than what is installed, and carries a package for this machine — which is the one case in which there is something to install.

notes_url.description: The release's own page, where what changed is written.

problem.description: Why there is no answer, or why the newest release cannot be installed here: no connection, no package for this machine.

published_at.description: When that release was published, as the repository writes it.

UpdateProgress.description:
Where the installer is, or where it stopped.

Written by the installer itself, which runs apart from the server: the server is restarted by the package it installs, and an install it ran itself would be killed half way.

at.description: When it last wrote this, as UTC in ISO 8601.

detail.description: What it is doing, or why it stopped, in a sentence.

version.description: The version it was asked for.
